slides.text:
pov: 400 day
duolingo streak
and you still can't
order coffee

talked to alya
for 10 minutes.
ordered real coffee
in spanish the
next day.

caption: knowing every conjugation chart by heart doesn't help if you freeze the second someone actually talks to you. save this 💚

slides.text:
you know every
conjugation chart
by heart

talking to alya felt
less scary than
talking to a human.
turns out that's
the whole trick.

caption: you understand every word your abuela says but reply in english anyway? this one's for you 🤍

slides.text:
you understand
every word your
abuela says

alya helped me find
the words I always
understood, but never
had to say.

caption: 3 weeks till your trip and still stuck on 'hola'? save this for your next trip ✈️

slides.text:
3 weeks till
your trip to
mexico city

10 minutes a day
with alya got me
through a whole
taco order.
en español.

caption: the subjunctive mood made you question your life choices. it finally clicked like this 📚

slides.text:
the subjunctive
mood made you
question your
life choices

"ojalá que apruebe"
finally clicked when
alya explained it
like a friend,
not a textbook.
